public_primary_sources.source_identity: Official OpenAI developer documentation on developers.openai.com
public_primary_sources.freshness_observation: Retrieved on 2026-09-18; the live page presents current model and API pricing, including GPT-6 Astra / GPT-5.6 family pricing and a note that GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing is available at least through 2026-11-21.
facts_vetted: The page lists positive per-1M-token input/output prices for current models; for example, gpt-5.6-luna is listed at $0.10 input and $0.60 output per 1M tokens in the displayed all-models pricing table.
The page states that Responses API is not priced separately, while tokens are billed at the chosen model's input and output rates.
The page also lists positive prices for built-in/tool usage where applicable.

source_identity_freshness.basis: Official OpenAI developer pricing page was retrieved directly during this invocation; no secondary-source substitution was used.

zero_monetary_cost.reason: Ordinary published OpenAI API usage has nonzero token pricing. The pricing page explicitly says Responses API is not separately priced but its model tokens are billed at the chosen model's input/output rates. Therefore this standard route does not satisfy a strict zero-monetary-cost gate absent separately verified entitlement covering the exact route.
